svg.title: Sharpness and decision usefulness are different
svg.desc: Empirical medians and interquartile ranges of upper-enclosed bound-to-gap ratios, not confidence intervals. Ratios divide the bound upper endpoint by the gap lower endpoint; zero-not-excluded cases are counted and omitted from this ratio. The lower panel reports sufficient decision certificates out of all 1,728 paired thresholds at each mixture weight. Unchanged, changed and unresolved cases remain in the denominator.
svg.title: Sharpness and decision usefulness are different
